regions.today: It'll be dry, mostly sunny and very warm or hot today. Highest temperatures of 24 to 29 degrees generally, warmest in the south, in mostly moderate northerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with mostly clear skies. Lowest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in light, occasionally moderate, north to northeast or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Sunday, will be a dry and a mostly sunny day. Warm or very warm generally with highest temperatures of 23 to 27 degrees generally. It'll be a little cooler by the east coast, due to the moderating effect of an onshore mostly moderate, occasionally fresh, easterly wind.
